Stop recording conversations so that fewer data privacy questions arise, and rely on executives' impressions
Replace the virtual agent with Grounding with Google Search so that answers come from the public web
Analyze the stored conversations with Conversational Insights to find the topics and sentiment in the escalated contacts

stem: A manager asks what the Customer Engagement Suite is and why a company would adopt it. Select TWO accurate descriptions. (Select TWO)

choices.text: It is a model-training service that requires a customer to build and train its own foundation model before any virtual agent can be used
It can reduce handling effort and improve consistency by automating routine inquiries and supporting representatives with generated responses
It is a developer-only code library without any ready-made products, so business teams cannot use any part of it directly
It is limited to email marketing campaigns and cannot be used for voice conversations with customers
It is a set of Google Cloud AI products for customer service, covering virtual agents, assistance for representatives and conversation analytics

stem: A hospital group wants a patient-facing website where visitors can ask natural-language questions about its clinics, services and visiting rules. The group wants answers limited to its own approved web pages and does not want the assistant to book appointments or change records. Which choice is the simplest fit?

choices.text: Grounding with Google Search, so the assistant can draw on every clinic website and medical page on the public web
Agent Search over the hospital's approved web pages, with generative answers that come only from that content
Contact Center as a Service, so patients reach a full omnichannel contact center before they can ask a question
Conversational Agents with flows that connect to the scheduling and records systems, since patients may need those later

stem: A retailer's contact center serves customers in many languages, and representatives who do not speak a customer's language rely on colleagues or slow manual translation. The retailer wants to improve resolution time without replacing its representatives. Which feature of the Customer Engagement Suite directly supports this need?

choices.text: Agent Assist, which provides representatives with live translation along with suggested responses and summaries
Grounding with Google Search, which translates the customer's phone call for the representative in real time
Conversational Insights dashboards that show sentiment by language after the contact has finished
Agent Search on the retailer's website that returns answers only in the language of the site's pages

stem: A bank evaluates a platform for its customer service. Select TWO statements that correctly describe business value of Google Cloud Contact Center as a Service. (Select TWO)

choices.text: It trains and hosts the bank's own foundation model, which the bank must then connect to its call recordings
It requires that every customer interaction be answered by a virtual agent, with no way to reach a human representative
It lets a customer move between voice, chat and digital channels with the interaction context preserved for a consistent experience
It provides only a search box for the bank's website and is unable to handle voice calls or routing
It uses AI for routing, self-service and agent support, so routine work is automated and representatives focus on valuable contacts

stem: A consumer-electronics company has three separate requests from different teams. Team X wants its public support site to answer questions from its own product manuals. Team Y wants a voice virtual agent that can check an order's status and arrange a return. Team Z wants the quality team to find calls with angry customers. Which assignment of offerings is best?

choices.text: Team X uses Conversational Insights, Team Y uses Agent Search, and Team Z uses Conversational Agents
Team X uses Agent Assist, Team Y uses Conversational Insights, and Team Z uses Grounding with Google Search
Team X uses Grounding with Google Search, Team Y uses Agent Assist, and Team Z uses Agent Search
Team X uses Agent Search, Team Y uses Conversational Agents, and Team Z uses Conversational Insights
